title: In "Asset QR Code Tag" report screen, add "Location Name" and "Asset Type" field
description: In "Asset QR Code Tag" report screen, add "Location Name" and "Asset Type" field
originating_prompt:
In "Asset QR Code Tag" report screen, add "Location Name" and "Asset Type" fields in criteria, show all the "Asset Type" and "Location Name" details under respective fields and allow user to select asset type and location. Remove "Asset Code" field from the screen and add above field instead. When user has selected "Asset Type" and "Location Name" it should generate list of QR code Jasper reports and display on the preview screen.
[follow-up] in the same "Asset QR Code Tag" screen, allow users to select "(any)" or empty "Asset Type", make this field optional, and if "Location Name" is selected start generating the QR code jasper reports and show the list
[follow-up] in the same "Asset QR Code Tag" screen, remove  "(any)" from the "Asset Type" dropdown field and make "(Any)" as by default
